title: Reconcile and record the completed next-wave task set

comments.body: This wave completed twenty independently scoped tasks TSK-0213 through TSK-0232, covering scheduler cancellation/lifecycle, Body arc-length performance and regressions, SDF IR validation/fail-closed behavior, mesh resource safety, diagnostics invariants, skeleton/topology regressions, and semantic-ID rigid binding.
